verify_points.desc: The project component registry lists available component JS files and the subset used by a composition.
A local CLI validates component IDs, files, required mount/update exports, import-free single-file ABI, track usage, and observed params.
A bad component is blocked with structured JSON errors instead of silently disappearing in preview or export.
The same validated component source still compiles into preview/export runtime source without changing the existing showreel output path.

items.title: Component registry and ABI validator in nf-project

ai_tools.expected: JSON report has ok=true, available_components, used components, params, and empty errors

items.evidence: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf composition validate --project=v2-showcase --composition=showreel-24s reported ok=true, available=13, used=9, errors=[]

items.title: nf composition validate

ai_tools.expected: prints JSON report with ok=false and exits 2

items.evidence: Positive validation exited 0. Negative fixture missing update printed ok=false with error "component 'html.hero-title' missing export function update" and exited 2.

items.title: Preview/export source compatibility

ai_tools.expected: showreel still exports through the same compiled source path

items.evidence: Draft export wrote ../NextFrame.archive/v0.17.0-verify/showreel-24s.mp4; ffprobe duration=24.000000; source JSON contains 9 source.components keys matching validated usage.
